issue_title: [Bug] save() truncates content if os.fdopen write fails mid-stream
fix_summary: Added explicit f.flush() before os.replace() in save() method to ensure data is persisted to disk before atomic rename. This catches disk-full errors early and prevents potential truncation issues.
risks: The explicit flush adds minimal overhead but ensures data integrity
No breaking changes - this is a defensive improvement
acceptance_criteria_met: If write fails due to disk full, temp file is cleaned up and not renamed
Original file remains unchanged on partial write failure
